scope: Small-batch slot extension during graph verifications plus four fusion boundaries in the own prompt only.

G01.decision: 文本 embedding 与图外查表沿用原估值。新增多模态读者才重开。

G02.decision: 两处 Post→Pre 共读残差，与 Attention 首 token 在同一请求上计价。

G03.decision: 归一化与共享量化只计匹配的行、比例因子和舍入；两处 mHC 已归 G02。

G04.decision: QA/index-W 联合投影须有相同就绪点和可省的读写。

G05.decision: 沿用旋转、量化、缓存发布和草稿三层估值，保持两流和旁路读者。

G06.decision: C2 投影与 pool/ring 的直接交付已低值；按查询分块另需实际可并行的第二组。

G07.decision: 区分已测的四层 QLI 共用与长提示 SMLA 内部交付；关键未知为有效行与新访问速率。

G08.decision: 大 prefill 的 OA→OB 分块可能改善首 token；M24 走回退，大行须有可兑现的重叠。

G09.decision: 路由分数至 TopK/dispatch 的实际物化单列；改变专家放置不计。

G10.decision: 固定路由的激活写读与共享输出合并已定价，现有 GMM 的组内行只计一次。

G11.decision: Engram 的 gate、WKV、残差及公共输入沿用同负载估值；改变通信协议单列。

G12.decision: 末层、aux 检查点和完整 raw 按真实读者归属，避免与词表头重复。

G13.decision: 冻结 greedy 交付已定价。启用提示评分后，按实际评分行、K 和通信块重估。

G14.decision: 验证 seed 和计数与 G17 合算。随机性、惩罚和返回分数改变输出需求。

G15.decision: 三路辅助状态与草稿 context KV 分别定价，同一份拼接只计一次。

G16.decision: 五步 W2 保留前驱 ID。分数面与窄 ID 分开，下一轮输入引用 G17。

G17.decision: 稳定满批 slot 已实测；普通 B1 同时考虑 13/26 项参与卡及另一 DP。

G18.decision: slot 坐标和扁平索引双输出、批量提交分别按已有基线归因，与 G17 共用估值。

G19.decision: 只给具名算子减少的提交与等待定价。换批和 B1 的状态主机收益仍未知。

G20.decision: 冷热专家和权重迁移归档。只有返回张量的生产者能直写读者时才计融合增量。

G21.decision: 八个冻结和六个普通文本请求没有图像；图像负载的算子合同保留，时延未知。

assumptions: All graph entries are the pre-call monotonic host timestamp, one active observation generation. The second DP also enters even when it owns no request. Shared ordinal is anchored at each rank’s same first full 40-layer eager prompt with matching row count and later common call sequence. A ghost event before the anchor is excluded.

The slot model assumes each active DP delivers the same example gain to its eight host graph entrants after its local input SUM. Idle DP gains zero. Lag models an additional fixed DP0-versus-DP1 difference from the observed host-entry clocks to a common later dependency; -1,0,+1 ms is a sensitivity. Task queues and actual F21 arrivals are unmeasured here. The full-DP-exposure scenario waives this host join assumption.

Use each observed request’s mean projected slot gain per graph step with each independent stock generation’s actual verification count; a competing eager prefill can cost one graph step. This transfers the observed DP pattern; routing, hit, exposure and spread can differ. Six ordinary text cases are not population weights.

Prompt fusion preserves the four existing mHC, compressed KV, PV, OA/OB assumptions (256 selected positions, half exposure and overlap, 90% reference resource rates) and takes just the own prefill term. Later graph attention, QLI reuse and B4 batching add no separate credit. Same-request serial transmission is a scenario; host or client overlap may hide either part. Fixed 1% ranking guide, no new service measurement.
